doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR2: Users can log in securely and maintain sessions across devices. Authentication requirements include secure password storage, session management with secure tokens, and role-based access control.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: NextAuth.js 4.24.12 for authentication handling and session management. Session strategy: JWT with refresh token rotation. Session expires 7 days, refresh token expires 30 days. Authentication flow uses NextAuth.js with secure HTTP-only cookies.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Redis-based rate limiting, configurable per endpoint. Import endpoints have stricter limits. Auth endpoints have standard limits. Rate limiting prevents brute force attacks and abuse.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story acceptance criteria and technical notes. NextAuth.js session management with secure cookie storage. Session strategy: JWT with refresh token rotation. Rate limiting via Redis or middleware (5 attempts/hour/IP). Security logging for audit trail.

doc.title: Story 1.2 - User Registration
doc.snippet: Auth infrastructure available: NextAuth.js configured with CredentialsProvider using Supabase Auth. Session management helpers at src/lib/auth/nextauth-helpers.ts. Validation utilities at src/lib/auth/validation.ts. Form components: ShadCN/UI Form with react-hook-form integration. Error handling: Error mapping service available. Icon system: Icon wrapper component at src/components/ui/icon.tsx. Animation system: Animation utilities at src/lib/animations.ts. PageTransition component at src/components/layout/PageTransition.tsx.

doc.title: Story 1.1 - Visual Design System
doc.snippet: Design system foundation with ShadCN/UI components, Tailwind CSS theme (Competitive Data theme colors), responsive breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px), WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance, and PageTransition component for smooth page transitions.

tests.standards: Test Coverage: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Test Types: Unit tests for components and utilities, integration tests for API endpoints, E2E tests for complete login flow, accessibility tests using axe-core. TDD Approach: Write tests before implementation, follow Red-Green-Refactor cycle. Accessibility Testing: Use @axe-core/playwright for E2E accessibility testing, verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Form Testing: Test all validation scenarios, error states, loading states, and success flows. Security Testing: Test rate limiting, account enumeration prevention, failed login attempt logging.
